subject: general
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence and select the option that rectifies the misspelling.

There are difficult times too, especially when the economy takes a dip and we have to lai people off.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lai"** is incorrectly spelt. It does not have a specific meaning in English. (अर्थहीन)

 
 
• **Example:** The word "lai" is a misspelling and does not fit in the context of the sentence.
 
 
 
• **"Lay"** refers to putting something down or setting it in place, particularly in a horizontal position. (रखना)
 
 
• **Example:** We had to **lay** off several employees due to budget cuts.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Economie** (अर्थव्यवस्था): This is an incorrect spelling of "economy".

 
 
• **Example:** The economy is showing signs of recovery.
 
 
 
• **Dificult** (कठिन): This is an incorrect spelling of "difficult".
 
 
• **Example:** The exam was very difficult.
 
 
 
• **Dipe** (डुबकी): This is an incorrect spelling of "dip".
 
 
• **Example:** The stock market took a dip last week.
